mapper.sql: price_alert_id AS priceAlertId, account_id AS accountId, symbol, direction, threshold, (SELECT i.quote_currency FROM instrument i WHERE i.symbol = price_alert.symbol) AS currency, status, triggered_price AS triggeredPrice, triggered_at AS triggeredAt, created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM price_alert WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT FROM price_alert WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, price_alert_id DESC
